name: netdust-gates
description: 0.3.0: the checks registry — every shake-out registers what it leaves in specs/CHECKS.md: the flows it drove as @e2e (make e2e env=staging, the proof after a deploy or a plugin update) and a fixture-free, read-only @smoke check per surface (make smoke, production too). shakeout-check fails a driven feature with no e2e or no smoke row, a missing test, a test without its tier's tag; /shakeout reads the registry first. 0.2.0: /plan-review — a fresh plan-reviewer subagent ground-truths the plan's premises against the source before Stefan reads it, files specs/<f>/plan-review.md naming the plan's blob, and the guard refuses product code while a plan open on this branch has no review of its current text. Netdust's software-delivery policy over superpowers: standards injected into the spec and plan, verification by executables (make gate, the shake-out manifest check), authority hooks. Pilot on netdust.be; replaces netdust-agent there and never runs beside it.
